frozen_before: reading microsoft.avt; the existing archive member listing and public dataset documentation were seen
reason: R2 PlanetLab test has only one recovery and no UP-DOWN-UP cycle, so its positive scheduling difference cannot independently validate recurrence.
source: microsoft.avt from the already checksum-pinned availability-0.3 archive
provenance: Bolosky, Douceur, Ely, Theimer, SIGMETRICS 2000: hourly probes of 51,662 corporate desktop PCs over 35 days. This is machine availability, not HTTP service quality.

sampling.starts: All nonoverlapping full 32-slot windows, beginning at index 1. No training or tuning on this domain.
sampling.selection: At each window start, require only an earlier first up. Sort eligible nodes by SHA256(microsoft/window_start/node_identifier); take the first 120 and partition into 20 disjoint six-node groups. No replacements for censored groups.
sampling.unknown: Same R2 rule: before first up or at/after last interval end is unknown; common prefix truncation; retain all selection and censoring counts.

frozen_methods: Use exactly R2's primary-web-trained rates, ten policies, and the two fixed R2B price baselines; no recalibration, selection, new hyperparameters or new policy.
workload: Same R2 arrival/value/deadline/buffer contract; workload identifier is window_start*100+group, dataset=microsoft.
primary_comparator: independent_two_step as selected on original web development data
new_claim_gate: At least 20 usable distinct time blocks and at least 50 evaluated groups with a same-node UP-DOWN-UP cycle; then positive lower 95% time-block-clustered CI for candidate versus selected comparator AND no-observation ablation. Passing does not establish novelty or deployment efficacy.
bootstrap: 2000 resamples, seed23031; cluster all groups at the same time window to preserve shared outages; additionally report per-node coverage without publishing identifiers
limits: Old coarse-grained availability data; synthetic request demand; common observation-point and endpoint-retirement ambiguity remain. No modern Flink performance or real customer benefit claim.
